comments.author: @geraldgardner516
comments.text:
See http://www.uspto.gov

Provisional Application for Patent  $65 for a "micro-entity"
http://www.uspto.gov/patents-getting-started/patent-basics/types-patent-applications/provisional-application-patent

Filing a Non-provisional gets a bit more detailed...
Content of Provisional and Nonprovisional Applications
http://www.uspto.gov/sites/default/files/inventors/Checklist_for_Filing_a_Nonprovisional_Utility.pdf

Checklist for Filing a Nonprovisional Utility Patent Application with the USPTO
http://www.uspto.gov/web/offices/pac/mpep/s601.html#d0e36538

Anyone can file a provisional or non-provisional patent application
https://efs.uspto.gov/EFSWebUIUnregistered/EFSWebUnregistered


Lot of information requires only the right question asked once and lots requires the wrong question asked until you get it right but many operators are SUPER helpful.

Call the USPTO Main Line 866-217-9197
Press the option for the EFS Web  (It was #2)
Press the option for an agent (It was #8)
These operator have always answered the phone with a minute for me.
Answer the operators questions i.e. Your First, Last name and email address.
Say I would like to...
1) Find out how to...
2) Find out what to do to file a provisional and/or non-provisional patent.
 
Call the USPTO Office of Innovation Development 866-767-3848
You may have to wait on hold quite a while but they have always answered for me eventually ~10-15 minutes
.
Call the USPTO Application Assistance Center 571-272-4000

Good luck, the information is all out there!
